paragrafi: INFORMATION NOTICE PURSUANT TO ART. 13 OF THE GENERAL DATA PROTECTION REGULATION
GDPR – EC REGULATION, EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT 27/04/2016 NO. 679, O.J.

With the entry into force of EU Regulation 679/2016 GDPR, containing provisions for the protection of individuals and other subjects with regard to the processing of personal data, ARNO PLAST S.r.l., as Data Controller, is required to provide some information on the use of personal data. We therefore inform you that the personal data provided, or otherwise acquired in compliance with the legislation in force – inherent, connected and/or instrumental to the existing relationships – may be processed, in compliance with the above-mentioned legislation and with confidentiality obligations. “Processing of personal data” means their collection, recording, organisation, storage, processing, modification, selection, extraction, comparison, use, interconnection, blocking, communication, dissemination, deletion and destruction, or a combination of two or more of these operations.

Purposes of the processing for which the data are intended;   The data collected through communications to the e-mail address of ARNO PLAST S.r.l. will be processed only to the extent required to provide the service requested. The recorded data may also be used for the administrative relations of our business; for the time being they will not be used to send the data subject commercial information relating to it, other than that explicitly requested by the data subject.

Methods of processing of the data  ; The processing of data will be carried out by means suitable to guarantee security and confidentiality, and the data will be processed mainly with computer tools and stored on computer media, on paper media and on any other suitable type of medium. We also inform you that personal data will be processed in compliance with the methods set out in EU Regulation 679/2016 GDPR, which provides, among other things, that the data must be:
processed lawfully and fairly;
collected and recorded for specified, explicit and legitimate purposes;
accurate and, where necessary, kept up to date;

relevant, complete and not excessive in relation to the purposes of the processing. The processing of data is carried out by the Controller through its personnel authorised to process the data and by any third parties appointed in advance as processors pursuant to Arts. 24 – 25 – 26 – 27 – 28 – 29 – 30 – 31, who operate under the control and responsibility of the Controller.   3. Subjects to whom the data may be communicated  Where necessary for the purposes referred to in point 1), the data may also be communicated to third parties such as persons within our company authorised to process personal data; to our consultants, within the limits necessary to carry out their assignment for our company.   4. Rights of the data subject  In relation to the above processing, you may exercise the rights set out in EU Regulation 679/2016 GDPR, Chapter III – Rights of the data subject
Transparency and arrangements, Art. 12
Information and access to personal data, Arts. 13 – 14 – 15
Rectification and erasure, Arts. 16 – 17 – 18 – 19 – 20 – 21 – 22
Right to object and automated individual decision-making, Art. 23

In summary, the data subject has the right to obtain confirmation of the existence or otherwise of personal data concerning them, even if not yet recorded, and to have such data communicated to them in an intelligible form.   The data subject has the right to obtain an indication of:
the origin of the personal data;
the purposes and methods of the processing;
the logic applied in the case of processing carried out with the aid of electronic tools;
the identification details of the controller, the processors and the designated representative;
the subjects or categories of subjects to whom the personal data may be communicated, or who may become aware of them as processors of specific processing.
The data subject has the right to obtain:
the updating, rectification or, where of interest, the integration of the data;

the erasure, anonymisation or blocking of data processed in breach of the law, including data whose retention is not necessary in relation to the purposes for which the data were collected or subsequently processed;

the certification that the data have been erased, also by the third-party processors to whom they were communicated or disseminated, in order to carry out the formalities requested by the data subject or required by law, except where this proves impossible or involves a manifestly disproportionate use of means in relation to the right protected. The data subject has the right to object, in whole or in part:
on legitimate grounds, to the processing of personal data concerning them, even if relevant to the purpose of the collection;
to the processing of personal data concerning them for the purposes of sending advertising material or direct selling, or for carrying out market research or commercial communication.
